formNotFound.title: Form Not Found
formNotFound.description: The form you're looking for doesn't exist or you don't have permission to view its automations.

automationNotFound.title: Automation Not Found
automationNotFound.description: This automation doesn't exist or has been deleted.

header.title: Automations
header.description: Build workflows that trigger on form events

readOnlyNotice: You have view-only access to this form's automations.

emptyState.title: No automations yet
emptyState.description: Create your first automation to trigger emails, webhooks, and more when this form is submitted.

createDialog.title: New automation
createDialog.description: Give your automation a name and pick what starts it.

renameDialog.title: Rename automation
renameDialog.description: Choose a new name for this automation.

deleteDialog.title: Delete automation?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and cancels any in-flight runs. This can't be undone.

builder.comingSoon: The visual builder is coming soon. You'll be able to design trigger → rules → actions flows here.
builder.readOnlyNotice: You have view-only access to this automation. Editing and activation are disabled.

header.saveInvalidMessage: Fix the highlighted steps and try again.
header.activateInvalidMessage: Fix the highlighted steps and try again.
header.unsavedChangesConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
header.testDisabledNoResponses: This form has no responses yet — submit one to test this automation.

trigger.title: Form submission
trigger.subtitle: Start automation when {{form}} is Completed
trigger.subtitleResponseEdited: Start automation when a response to {{form}} is edited

trigger.description: This automation starts every time someone completes this form.
trigger.descriptionResponseEdited: This automation starts every time a response to this form is edited.
trigger.descriptionSchedule: This automation starts on the schedule below — it doesn't have a triggering response, so steps can't reference response fields.

schedule.invalidCron: Enter a valid 5-field cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * *".
schedule.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, e.g. "America/Chicago".
schedule.hint: Times are evaluated in the timezone above (defaults to UTC if left blank).
schedule.saveSuccessMessage: This automation's schedule has been updated.

end.description: The automation finishes here — nothing runs after this step.

action.noConfigForm: This action can't be configured yet.

delay.hint: The next step runs after this delay has passed.

digest.hint: The first run matches every response satisfying your filters below, no matter when it was submitted. Every run after that only picks up responses submitted since the last run, so nothing gets emailed or processed twice. Add a Condition step next to skip the rest when there's nothing new — check "New responses count".
digest.noFiltersHint: No filters — every response is included (see the hint below for how the schedule stays incremental). Add a filter to narrow it down (e.g. only a specific tag or score range).

condition.noRulesHint: Add at least one rule. Responses matching it follow the Yes branch; everything else follows No.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: Runs appear here once this automation is triggered by a form submission or a test run.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this run?
cancelConfirm.description: This stops the run at its current step. Steps that already completed aren't undone.

detail.title: Run detail
detail.description: Step-by-step execution log for this run.
